title: A fireball and its shadow on the clouds
description:
Astronomers say the 2017 fireball was seen all over Europe. Many people reported it.
NASA picture: JPL, PIA22825. MISR, Bering Sea fireball, 2018.
Every day’s picture: https://cosmos.rimilab.com/
Today’s APOD photo is by Ollie Taylor: https://science.nasa.gov/image-article/apod-2026-november-8-major-fireball-meteor/. To use it, please ask the owner.
